en:
The piece of fabric...came from Kirumi's
<CLT=cltSTRONG>black glove<CLT=cltNORMAL>!
Kirumi's glove?

If the culprit were slowing their descent
by grabbing the rope with their hands...

there would have been a lot of <CLT=cltSTRONG>friction<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
Easily enough to cause rope burn.

But our culprit was smart. They weren't
burned because they weren't bare-handed.

Yeah! The culprit had gloves on!
One got all torn up from the friction and...
And...it fell into pool?

From what I remember, the only one who wears
black gloves is Kirumi, right?

The gloves on your hands now...
I take it they're from your dorm?

The extra uniforms in our rooms are made
of the same material we're wearing now.

We can test my theory by comparing the
fabric scrap with your glove.
Gh...grgh...
...Well, Kirumi?

Will you allow us to compare the black fabric
we found in the pool with your gloves?
U-Uhhh...!

Huh? What's the matter?
Why are you sweating so much?
Kirumi...what's wrong?
Hrghhhh...uuuuhhhhhh...!

<CLT=cltMIND>In the end...I'm just like them.
I'm scared of revealing the truth.

<CLT=cltMIND>Because it means that someone has
to be sacrificed. But Kaede was scared, too...

<CLT=cltMIND>She didn't let that stop her.
She thought things through to the end.

<CLT=cltMIND>I faced the truth, and doubted it,
and kept thinking, and kept going...

<CLT=cltMIND>This is where it led me.
And I won't turn away from it.
I will show you the truth.
